The second edition is a super luxurious limited edition special set with a glittering look!
'Select the super popular BB warriors representing the 90's!
Also includes the treasure item “Crystal Phoenix”! !

• Musha Gotomaru Metallic Ver. (EX Finish Silver & Gloss Injection)
• 4th Gendamutaishogun Full Color Clear Ver. (Color Clear Molding)

• Hiten Gundam Cho Shogun Cho White Steel EX Finish-Ver. (EX Finish Silver)
• "Crystal Phoenix" from 'Legendary General Guidance Volume' (gold plated)
